description: Honeydew Cook helps you organize your saved recipes, household grocery list, and meal plan. Search your private cookbook, read ingredients and steps, save or edit recipes, and organize folders and tags. With your permission, add ingredients to your household grocery list and schedule saved recipes on your meal plan. Requires a Honeydew account; shared lists and plans require a Honeydew homegroup, which can have one member. Changes to household lists and plans are visible to other homegroup members. Honeydew does not search store inventory or prices, place orders, or process payments.

defaultPrompt: Find chicken recipes in my saved Honeydew cookbook.
Show my recently saved recipes, folders, and tags.
Show our household meal plan for this week and our grocery list.

positive.description: Search the user's saved recipes and open the best match.
positive.prompt: Find my saved chicken and spinach recipes, then show me the full ingredients and steps for the best match.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns matching saved recipes, then the selected recipe's full ingredients and ordered instructions.

positive.description: Discover recent recipes and how the user's library is organized.
positive.prompt: Show my five most recently saved recipes, then list my recipe folders and the tags I use.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns five recent recipes plus the user's folder names, recipe counts, and tag usage counts.

positive.description: Save a complete recipe and organize it in a new folder.
positive.prompt: Save this recipe to Honeydew and put it in a new folder named Weeknight Review Tests: Lemon Pasta, serves 2, takes 20 minutes. Ingredients: 200 g spaghetti, 1 lemon (zest and juice), 30 g butter, and 40 g grated parmesan. Steps: 1. Boil the spaghetti according to its package directions. 2. Melt the butter and stir in the lemon zest and juice. 3. Toss the drained pasta with the sauce and parmesan.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates one Lemon Pasta recipe with the supplied amounts and ordered steps, and a Weeknight Review Tests folder containing it. Reuses request IDs for identical retries to avoid duplicate writes.

positive.description: Add a saved recipe to the household grocery list and organize the result.
positive.prompt: I confirm: add the ingredients from my saved creamy carbonara recipe to our household grocery list, organize the full unchecked list by merging only clear duplicates, and then show me the updated list.
positive.expected_behavior: Adds the recipe ingredients, consolidates every unchecked item exactly once, preserves checked items, and returns the updated list grouped by store section.

positive.description: Plan a saved recipe for the household and read back the weekly plan.
positive.prompt: I confirm: add my saved creamy carbonara to our household meal plan for next Monday, then show the plan for that week.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates one meal-plan entry for the resolved recipe on next Monday and returns the household plan for that week.

negative.description: Do not trigger for a general recipe request that excludes the user's saved library.
negative.prompt: Give me a classic French omelet recipe from general knowledge; do not use my saved recipes.
negative.expected_behavior: The app should not be invoked because the user explicitly requested general cooking knowledge rather than Honeydew data.

negative.description: Do not trigger for an unrelated calendar request.
negative.prompt: What meetings do I have on my calendar tomorrow?
negative.expected_behavior: The app should not be invoked because Honeydew does not provide calendar or meeting data.

negative.description: Do not trigger for local shopping or price-search requests.
negative.prompt: Find grocery stores near me with the cheapest eggs today.
negative.expected_behavior: The app should not be invoked because Honeydew does not search stores, locations, inventory, or prices.

review.commerce_description: Honeydew Cook does not sell products or process payments through the plugin.

publication.release_notes: Updates the Productivity listing and supported capabilities; includes an explicit remote MCP connection, listing icons, and three Honeydew skills; adds five positive and three negative review cases; links the dedicated connector privacy policy.
